correctness.rationale: Enumerating involutions by fixing/swapping the least unused position and filtering all 321 triples is exhaustive; the comparison mask maps permutations injectively, and counts match binom(n,floor(n/2)). Exact VC search adds query supports in strictly increasing order and keeps all nonempty pattern fibers, pruning only unsplittable singletons. Exact online recurrence for version spaces splits on all comparison pairs, with sound cardinality pruning; the source traverses every n<=12. Independently reconstructed sorted 321-avoiding involutions from scratch at n11 and n12 and validated the actual Git JSON tree certificates: depth7 at n11, 127 internal queries and 128 distinct valid path witnesses; depth8 at n12, 255 queries and 256 distinct valid witnesses. Independently evaluated every query minority split, maxima 126 at n11 and 252 at n12, strictly below 128 and 256 needed for deeper trees, proving critical Ldim upper bounds. Full finite claims only n<=12; no extrapolation.

evidence: General VC/Ldim and full permutation bounds do not give equality for the restricted intersection of involutions and 321-avoiders; the central binomial concept count provides only Ldim<=floor(log2 |C|).
